title: Emergency conference at Camp Hood on nuclear-site UFOs

tellings.quote: an emergency conference was held at Camp Hood, Texas, which included the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Army Counter Intelligence Command, and the FBI.

plain: An emergency meeting about UFOs seen near nuclear sites was held at Camp Hood, an Army post in Texas, bringing together the Air Force's criminal and counterintelligence investigators, the Army's counterintelligence branch, and the FBI, the US federal police. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source or giving a date. If true, it would show that several security agencies treated the sightings as a serious threat.
